svg.title: Source-linked QQ delivery observations
svg.desc: A stored reply reserves a retained attempt and records each request before dispatch. Valid acknowledgements permit another part. Rejections, uncertain results and new-input interruptions stop later sends. A platform acknowledgement does not establish recipient delivery or reading.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
回复已入库
来源 ID / 原文 SHA-256

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
授权范围内登记尝试
已有记录则不再发送

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
登记片段与请求指纹
调用 QQ 发送 API

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
片段获平台回执
HTTP 成功 + ok + retcode 0
有效消息编号

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
计划片段全部结束
已获平台回执 · 非已读

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
明示拒绝
保留已确认片段，停止后续

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
结果未知
停止后续，不自动重发

div.style: color: rgb(113, 63, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center;

span.p:
新输入或本地失败中断
保留已确认片段
